title: Private-Input Reserves Cover Outstanding Check
description: Pilot private-input predicate: 16 committed reserve slots, tagged by the eight GENIUS Act 4(a)(1)(A) categories, must cover the committed payment stablecoins outstanding. OCG section 25: inputs are sha256-salted@1 commitments, the receipt holds only the yes/no verdict. Integer only, no haircut, witness is 16 slots of 20 digits. Not proof reserves exist, are unencumbered, approved, or free of 4(a)(2) rehypothecation, nor the Act monthly report. Proof deferred; result is a preview, not a receipt.

input_example.citation: GENIUS Act (Pub. L. 119-27) section 4(a)(1)(A): reserves backing outstanding payment stablecoins on an at least 1 to 1 basis, in the reserve categories listed in (i) to (viii).

output_example.basis: Shows that the committed reserve amounts, in the categories the GENIUS Act lists, add up to at least the committed amount outstanding. It does not show the reserves exist, are unencumbered, or are approved where approval is required, and it does not replace the monthly report the Act requires.
output_example.privacy_note: The verdict is public. The inputs are not in the receipt. A receipt made from inputs you gave a server was seen by that server. Each receipt answers one yes/no question; asking many questions about the same figures reveals more.
output_example.not_legal_advice: Not legal or regulatory advice. Reserve adequacy determinations require review by the issuer's qualified finance and compliance staff and the applicable regulator.
